item.text: I’ll trace the SSH multiplexer and its existing tests, record the checkpoint first, then implement the prefix handling and run the relevant repository tests.

item.command:
/bin/sh -lc "mkdir -p .codex-role-output && cat > .codex-role-output/checkpoint.md <<'EOF'
# Checkpoint

Task: Support inbound SSH connections prefixed with "'`Teleport-Proxy`, a JSON payload, and a null terminator. Classify these as SSH and expose a payload `ClientAddr` as the connection'"'s remote address while preserving standard SSH behavior.

Progress: Starting repository inspection. I will use checked-out code and existing tests only.
EOF
pwd && rg --files -g 'AGENTS.md' -g '*ssh*' -g '*proxy*' -g 'go.mod' -g 'Cargo.toml' -g 'package.json' | head -200"

/bin/sh -lc "mkdir -p .codex-role-output && cat > .codex-role-output/checkpoint.md <<'EOF'
# Checkpoint

Task: Support inbound SSH connections prefixed with "'`Teleport-Proxy`, a JSON payload, and a null terminator. Classify these as SSH and expose a payload `ClientAddr` as the connection'"'s remote address while preserving standard SSH behavior.

Progress: Starting repository inspection. I will use checked-out code and existing tests only.
EOF
pwd && rg --files -g 'AGENTS.md' -g '*ssh*' -g '*proxy*' -g 'go.mod' -g 'Cargo.toml' -g 'package.json' | head -200"
/bin/sh -lc "find .. -name AGENTS.md -print; ls -la; find . -maxdepth 3 -type f \\( -name 'go.mod' -o -iname '*ssh*' -o -iname '*mux*' \\) -print | head -200"
